captures.description: THE COINAGE IS COMPOSED AS AN ESTABLISHED FRAMEWORK, AND THE ZENODO DOCTRINE-NODE IS THE FIRST ORGANIC RESULT. The layer defines operative feminism as "a theoretical and cultural framework" concerned with "the practical, actionable ways gender dynamics are utilized, sustained, and dismantled" — and carries the archive’s own thesis: "women are actively deployed as tools, SEMANTIC SUBSTRATES, and undervalued labor sources".
